text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with source quotes","quality":"development","description":"It develops its position with more elaboration and supporting detail rather than just stating an opinion."},{"evidence":"\"The text says...\" and \"The future of the smart cars could...\"","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It draws more directly on the article and tries to connect those details to the claim."},{"evidence":"organized introduction, body, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It has a clearer essay structure with distinct parts that guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"driverless cars help to add knowledge and protection\" / \"beneficial to the growth of the economy\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"It gives more than one reason for its stance and explains how the reasons are supposed to support the claim."},{"evidence":"concluding return to benefits and future impact","quality":"closure","description":"It ends with a more developed conclusion that restates the argument and looks ahead to the issue's importance."}]}
